Subject: Consolidated walkthrough: Greenhouse + Checkr renewals & contract terms

Hi all —

Our Greenhouse and Checkr annual agreements come up in May and June, respectively. To avoid duplicate negotiation cycles and keep the recruiting stack steady for Q2 hiring, I want to run a short consolidated contract walkthrough with both vendors plus Procurement and Legal on our side.

Attached is a snapshot of current terms and some open questions (see tab "asks"). High-level asks from our side:
- Greenhouse: clarity on multi-year discounts, seat license definitions for internal recruiters vs. hiring managers, and trial/pooled seats for campus hiring.
- Checkr: sustained volume pricing for 3 mo spikes, turnaround SLAs, and PII handling during manual reviews.

Proposed slots next week: Tue Apr 5 10:00-10:45 PT or Wed Apr 6 14:00-14:45 PT. If those don't work, share 2 alternatives.

Action: Laura, can you lead the product/usage review? Monica, please coordinate finance/PO timeline + any required approvals.

Thanks,
Karthik

Thanks Karthik — I can lead product/usage. A few notes after scanning the summary:
- We currently have ~18 active recruiter seats and ~120 hiring managers who open roles periodically. Any commercial model that charges per seat needs to clearly define "active recruiter" vs. "manager with occasional access."
- For campus pooled seats: we typically use temporary seats during the grad-hire window (June-Aug). Would like an explicit clause for seasonal seat bursting and guaranteed price caps.
- For integrations: we need assurance that Checkr results map cleanly into Greenhouse for candidate status automation. If there are any extra integration fees, flag them now.

Monica — on PO timing: what is the cutoff for legal to sign before hiring velocity is impacted? We might need an interim extension if we can't finalize multi-year terms by May 1.
